name: Owakare Aisai Onsen Ryokou ~Gomennasai Anata... Kodomo-tachi wa Oji-sama no Ko. Watashi wa Ano Hito no Tsuma ni Narimasu~
original_name: お別れ愛妻温泉旅行～ごめんなさいあなた…子供達は伯父さまの子。私はあの人の妻になります～
source:
The protagonist lived happily married with his beloved wife and kids. Unable to go with his wife on a family trip to the onsen, his uncle accompanies her!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069733.html]DLsite English[/url]]
